propositions: Documentation falsely claims bug tickets are gate-exempt with runner=exempt, contradicting actual code behavior where bugs receive light advisory review under bug tier
Code correctly implements bug review tier with DET floor and necessity probe instead of short-circuiting to bare exempt pass
Two distinct exemption axes exist: CLI-side claim-time exemption for bugs versus plan-review gate review eligibility, and documentation conflates them
Acceptance criteria require correcting stale claims in docs/plan-review-gate.md and review_plan docstring to reflect that only session_log/code_review/identity are gate-exempt types
Bug tier review is intentional feature per epic 6982, never blocked but always reviewed, and test_bug_review_tier.py already pins runner != exempt for bugs
